project.name: finance-portfolio-multi-underlying-leaps
project.description: Multi-underlying LEAPS support for the live portfolio management layer
project.overview: Extension to plans/portfolio_management.md. LeapsContract carries no underlying ticker today (implicitly VTI-only), so LivePortfolio cannot represent DITM LEAPS held on multiple tickers (e.g. VTI + IWM + GLD) and compute_portfolio_greeks cannot route spot/IV correctly across contracts. Scope is the live-management layer only (LeapsContract, greeks.py, portfolio_manager.py, both example scripts, figures.py table formatting); run_backtest/_backtest_steps.py keeps its existing single-LEAPS-underlying ValueError guard untouched. Fixing ticker routing also surfaces and fixes a latent, previously-unreachable bug: compute_leaps_holdings_view and compute_rebalance_plan currently split the aggregate LEAPS NAV across multiple *_LEAPS target-weight keys proportionally to target weight rather than actual per-ticker exposure.

testing.mutation_notes: mutmut is not present in this repo's pyproject.toml dev dependencies; mutation testing is not part of the existing toolchain, so it is marked disabled at the feature level rather than assumed.

data_schemas.name: LeapsContract
data_schemas.description: A single DITM LEAPS call contract position. Gains a ticker field so a contract can be tagged with the underlying it is written on.

fields.name: n_contracts
fields.description: Number of contracts (float for fractional allocation).

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: NEW. Underlying ticker (e.g. "VTI", "IWM", "GLD"). Defaults to "VTI" so every existing construction site is unaffected.

data_schemas.name: NavBreakdown
data_schemas.description: NAV decomposition for a LivePortfolio. Gains a per-ticker LEAPS MTM breakdown.

fields.name: leaps_nav_by_ticker
fields.description: NEW. Mark-to-market value per LEAPS underlying, caller-supplied via compute_nav_breakdown's leaps_mtm_by_ticker.

data_schemas.name: RebalancePlan
data_schemas.description: Simulated rebalance outcome for a LivePortfolio. leaps_trim becomes per-underlying.

fields.name: leaps_trim
fields.description: CHANGED: dict[str, float], was float. Per-underlying dollar overshoot keyed by bare ticker (not the "<ticker>_LEAPS" target_weights key). Empty dict when no sleeve is overweight.

api_contracts.name: compute_portfolio_greeks
api_contracts.description: Computes aggregate greeks across all active LEAPS contracts, routing each contract to its own underlying's spot/IV via contract.ticker.
raises: ValueError: one or more live contracts' tickers missing from spot or iv; message lists every missing ticker, not just the first

api_contracts.name: leaps_mtm_by_ticker
api_contracts.description: NEW. Sums position MTM (price * n_contracts * CONTRACT_MULTIPLIER * leaps_scale) grouped by contract.ticker.

api_contracts.name: compute_nav_breakdown
api_contracts.description: Decomposes LivePortfolio NAV into base, LEAPS (now per-ticker), defensive, and pool components.

inputs.name: leaps_mtm_by_ticker
inputs.note: CHANGED: was leaps_mtm: float = 0.0. None sentinel avoids a mutable default; normalized to {} inside.

api_contracts.name: compute_leaps_holdings_view
api_contracts.description: Computes weight-drift HoldingView rows for each *_LEAPS target_weights key using actual per-ticker exposure instead of target-weight-proportional split.

api_contracts.name: compute_rebalance_plan
api_contracts.description: Simulates rebalance trades. DRIFT branch and leaps_trim now use actual per-ticker LEAPS exposure instead of target-weight-proportional split.

api_contracts.name: leaps_trims_as_trade_orders
api_contracts.description: RENAMED from leaps_trim_as_trade_order (singular). Represents a RebalancePlan's per-ticker leaps_trim as TradeOrders for display, one per overweight sleeve.

api_contracts.name: _leaps_actual_weights_by_key
api_contracts.description: NEW private helper, shared by compute_leaps_holdings_view and compute_rebalance_plan's DRIFT branch. Maps each "<ticker>_LEAPS" target_weights key to nav.leaps_nav_by_ticker.get(ticker, 0.0) / total_nav.

api_contracts.name: build_leaps_contract
api_contracts.description: Constructs a LeapsContract for a position the caller already holds. Gains a ticker kwarg.

api_contracts.name: format_contract_greeks_table
api_contracts.description: Formats per-contract LEAPS greeks as a human-readable table string. Gains a ticker column.

risks.description: target_weights's *_LEAPS keys and LeapsContract.ticker tags are not cross-validated; a typo or forgotten tag silently shows a sleeve as 100% underweight rather than erroring.
risks.mitigation: _leaps_actual_weights_by_key uses .get(ticker, 0.0), matching existing behavior for any untracked target_weights key. Documented in plan Known Assumption 1 / Edge Cases.

risks.description: Backtest-bridged contracts (via as_live_portfolio) keep ticker='VTI' unconditionally; a future single-underlying backtest on a non-VTI ticker (e.g. 'IWM_LEAPS' alone, still valid since the engine only forbids >1) would mislabel its bridged contracts.
risks.mitigation: Deferred per plan Known Assumption 3 — no current config exercises a non-VTI single underlying. Fixing requires threading the real ticker through create_leaps_contract, roll_contract, and run_leaps_simulation call sites; flagged, not implemented in this spec.

risks.description: Mutable default argument footgun if leaps_mtm_by_ticker is implemented as dict[str, float] = {} instead of a None sentinel.
risks.mitigation: Use leaps_mtm_by_ticker: dict[str, float] | None = None; normalize to {} inside the function body. Never a mutable default argument.

risks.description: Adding a ticker field to LeapsContract could be mistaken by a future contributor as implicit license to also lift the backtest engine's single-LEAPS-underlying constraint.
risks.mitigation: _build_context's ValueError guard for >1 LEAPS underlying in target_weights is explicitly out of scope and must remain; M7 regression test enforces it stays untouched.

risks.description: leaps_trim is keyed by bare ticker (e.g. 'IWM'), not the '<ticker>_LEAPS' key used by HoldingView/TradeOrder, which can confuse a caller who indexes it directly instead of going through leaps_trims_as_trade_orders.
risks.mitigation: leaps_trims_as_trade_orders encapsulates the key-naming translation. Documented in plan Known Assumption 2 for any caller bypassing that helper.
